title: Client handoffs need evidence.
caption: Briefstamp turns requirements into approved checks and a report clients can read.

title: Start with six requirements.
caption: This hosted walkthrough uses a synthetic website and clearly labelled template checks.

title: Approval comes before execution.
caption: Review the plan, approve the checks, then run the browser audit.

title: A real browser. Observed outcomes.
caption: 5 passed · 0 failed · 1 unverified. A subjective requirement still needs human judgment.

title: Change the sample. Keep the assertions.
caption: Selecting the broken condition resets approvals. Review and approve again before running.

title: The broken website fails three checks.
caption: 2 passed · 3 failed · 1 unverified. Missing evidence never becomes a pass.

title: See what the browser actually found.
caption: The failed heading stays linked to its requirement and captured screenshot.

title: Restore the sample. Approve again.
caption: Same assertions. The operator restores the synthetic condition; this is not automatic repair.

title: Three recoveries, checked by Chromium.
caption: 5 passed · 0 failed · 1 unverified. The subjective requirement remains unresolved.

title: Compare the same checks across runs.
caption: 3 recovered · 2 still passing · 1 unknown. Changed or manual checks cannot prove a fix.

title: Send the site. Show the proof.
caption: Download a portable delivery report with observed results and screenshot evidence.
